decisions.scenario: Choosing a moderately priced restaurant in east Cambridge and asking for an address

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Hello. I'm looking for a moderately priced restaurant in the east part of town.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Do you have a preference for the type of food?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No, I don't mind.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are three options to choose from.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Okay. What are they?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Curry Prince and Rajmahal both serve Indian food, and Pizza Hut Fen Ditton serves Italian food.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Could I get the address of one of them?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Certainly. Curry Prince is at 451 Newmarket Road, Fen Ditton.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thank you. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You're welcome. Goodbye!
